about: How Sonic's body moves in BeamNG. BeamNG's walking-mode body (a balancing ball) carries him; the mod's vehicle extension adds Sonic's speed, boost and jump on top. Each row becomes SHEETS.physics.<id> in Lua.

rows.purpose: top running speed without boost (about 86 km/h)
top speed while boosting (about 190 km/h)
how fast Sonic reaches his running speed
how fast the boost pulls him forward
how fast he slows when the keys are released
how quickly his run turns toward the input direction
share of ground control kept in the air
upward speed of a jump (about 3 m high, the same at any speed)
added fall acceleration so jumps feel snappy
running on water: the ball skims this far under the surface (negative: just above it, out of BeamNG's water drag)
swimming: the ball's centre this far under the surface (chest-deep)
how hard the water pushes the ball back to its height (per metre off)
damps bobbing on the water
running on water: how fast a fall onto it is stopped (a deep plunge slowed him)
wall run: how fast his speed along the wall is held
wall run: pull holding him against the wall
wall run: speed of a jump away from the wall
wall run: push onto the top when he runs past the wall's upper edge
wall run: steepest normal (z) still a wall; flatter is a slope he just runs up
wall run: met this square-on (cos of the angle) he runs straight up, else along
wall run: upward speed left when he pops over the top of a wall
wall run: the wall must still be there this high above the ball (not a kerb)
wall run along a wall: how steeply he first climbs onto it before levelling out
water shallower than this: he has his footing and just runs
gap under the body that still counts as on the ground
default: speed gained every second of boost, with no top speed (menu: Boost acceleration)
default: whether the top-speed limit is on (menu: Speed limit)
default top speed when the limit is on (menu: Top speed)
how fast he slows back to running speed after letting go of boost
strongest sideways pull when turning at boost speed
extra grip at speed: pull to the ground = downforce x speed squared, on the ground only
above this the walking ball stops gripping and Sonic's own forces carry him (no rolling losses)
share of the ball's ground friction kept while gliding
speed controller: push per m/s Sonic is below his target speed
speed controller: how fast it learns the steady push that cancels drag and friction
strongest forward push the speed controller may use
target speed never runs further ahead of his real speed (walls do not wind it up)
ceiling on the speed grip, so he is never pressed through thin floors
after boost: share of the extra speed lost per second, on top of coastAccel
ground this close under a fast Sonic pulls him back onto it (seams and bumps do not launch him)
speed above which the ground snap works
how hard the ground snap pulls
share of the walking body's air drag Sonic keeps (Sonic ignores the air; huge drag forces would tear the soft body apart)
menu button Unstuck: Sonic goes back to the last spot he stood upright on at least this far from where he is
sprint speed given to BeamNG's walking controller so it never brakes Sonic
